name: Classic Hyena Warrior
bio: Laughs at everything, especially the last thing you tried.
notes: Retired to MapMaker 2026-11-25 (owner: "All replacements can be retired to the mapmaker for use in other creations such as scenarios"): the model Hyena Warrior (`core.hyena`) wore until the owner's new model of 2026-11-25 took that id, name and place. Its built files kept under this id; `use: figure`: off Character Select, bots, random picks and Roulette; MapMaker places it as a Figure (docs/CHARACTERS.md, "Retired to MapMaker"). Was: Digitigrade: the leg joints sit on the leg's centre line (read off a side profile), so straightening it turns the thigh and shin only a little and the knee doesn't fold; the hock is the ankle, the paw the foot. Its model replaced 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b, the owner's mapping) by "Gnoll warrior" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used); it was built from the owner's own model.
